title: EnchantSMPRaids
description: This is my first plugin, it adds a variety of difficulties with rewards according to their level. It's in beta, so expect to find many bugs.
body:
### EnchantSMP Raid Plugin
# difficulties:
-  Easy
-  Normal
-  Hard
-  Nightmare
> X4 Rewards
-  Infernum
> X6 Rewards
- Nether (Soon)
  - rewards
   - 30% Gold_Ingot (1-6)
   - 44% Obsidian (1-4)
   - 54% Blaze rood (1-3)
   - 3,5% Netherite scrap (1) 
- Ocean (Soon)
 - rewards
   - Nautilus Shells (2-5)
   - Heart of the Ocean (1)
   - Iron (8-15)
   - Gold (5-10)
   - Prismarine Crystals/Fragments
   - TRIDENT (2.5% chance) 🔱
   - Enchanted Books
   - Vortex Book (15% chance) 💙 

**What does this plugin add?**
- A new raid system with themed or difficulty-based rewards

**Why use it?**
- This plugin will make raids much more fun and offer new challenges! 

**The plugin is in alpha/beta state so expect it to have many bugs.**
